entityFieldPolicy: All 12 frozen canonical records, 20 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk list reviewed. Generic upstream/downstream/interaction fields are research prompts, not evidence. Behavior/complaint/withdrawal indicators are not automatically the perception. Null subtype/qualifier fields and no blocked canonical fields remain unchanged; suggested source/construct issues are separate candidate questions.
rdsReview: No local RDS. Incoming REL-SOC-067 has external SOC-096 RDS: GROUP_A_STATUS + GROUP_B_STATUS + COMMON_SOCIAL_FIELD, difference/gap rule, aligned window and uncertainty. PSY-022 is not a formula input; genuine appraisal mechanism remains possible but must be temporally independent from status ratings. No formula-as-causality, exogenous-root assumption or direct RDS effect target.
causalGateReview: REL-SOC-067 is HEIGHTENED_CAUSAL (SOC-096 RDS→PSY-022 Driver); all other incident endpoints are Drivers and STANDARD_CAUSAL. SOC-096 shared judgment inputs, selection, temporal order, gap specification and aggregate/constituent contribution require review. No RDS classifications changed.

layersConsidered.BIO: Sleep loss and oxytocin research screened; loneliness/distancing and trust-game outcomes do not automatically match local constructs.
layersConsidered.PSY: Appraisal, coping, belonging, trust and intention boundaries; own behavior and perceived norms may be reciprocal.
layersConsidered.SOC: Actual behavior/approval, support/contact, ostracism, status gaps and reference groups distinguished from perceptions.
layersConsidered.CUL: Reference-group/country moderation in normative and deprivation research; country is not a manipulable cultural construct.
layersConsidered.ENV: Thermal cues and disruption/contact-loss hypotheses screened; no exact psychological effect extracted from physical proximity or task behavior alone.
layersConsidered.INS: Oversight, service, corruption, fairness and policing research; actual institutional change not equated to perception regression.
layersConsidered.INF: Comparative normative feedback and corruption messages; truthful disclosure versus private appraisal separate.
layersConsidered.TEC: Virtual inclusion protocol and feedback interface; not actual friendship or network-state manipulation.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Virtual task protocol, normative feedback, support and institutional programs screened.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Ordinary expressed approval, observed peers and exclusion considered; controlled task does not establish all routine effects.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Disruption, scandal and contact-loss hypotheses considered; no exact uncontrolled occurrence-to-perception effect retained.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Temperature/proximity and disruption considered; trust-game or social-distancing proxies do not establish exact targets.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Real governance conditions and perception survey evidence separated; no policy occurrence as efficacy.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Bounded computer protocol is supported only at explicit perceptual scope; platform affordance changes not assumed equivalent.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Group contact, support, ostracism and observed norms considered; actual ties versus perceived conditions separated.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Norm estimates and corruption information reviewed; no guarantee of calibration/truth or behavioral consequence.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sleep/oxytocin literature screened with proxy and replication constraints.

propertyPolicy: Eleven properties considered, no quota. LEVEL has one narrowly supported effect and one unknown research effect. Other properties retain insufficient/not-investigated outcomes; STRUCTURE is not a way to edit perceptions, ties or PSYWERX Relationships. Nonsignificance is not supported null.
relationshipPropertyReview: All 21 incident exact edges considered after primary review/reuse. Support buffering, cultural reference-group differences, FoMO and normative feedback mediation do not supply aligned exact-edge modification evidence. No formal relationship-targeted effect/moderation/pathway; same contribution links EA-005 to REL-SOC-062 without summation.

skepticalReview.method: Second-pass falsification after initial source funnel: check direct result/measure against candidate target; review null/alternative evidence; verify exact source identity, ownership and contribution. Source metadata and publication summaries are not treated as empirical confirmation.
checks: Cyberball meta excludes manipulation checks: not used as direct exclusion-rating efficacy or an effect coefficient.
Young-adult ignored/excluded ratings align directly; age-six non-detection and measurement caveat preserved, no universal-age claim.
Holte FoMO/attachment interactions were not detected; no measured trait promoted to formal causal moderator.
PNF norm-item scope unresolved: retain UNKNOWN/RESEARCH_NEEDED, and downstream null alcohol results remain downstream.
Policing review inconclusive legitimacy and shared RISE evaluations retained; no trust/legitimacy substitution.
OECD causal caveats and WGI aggregate limitation override causal-sounding narrative arrows for review recommendations only.
SOC-096 external RDS reviewed under D10; no direct RDS effect, formula edge or new entity.
Actual/perceived norms, approval/anticipated approval, belonging/exclusion/loneliness and person/institution trust remain separate.
Two feedback operations compared against all current HT/Intervention identities and earlier Layer candidates; no material identity match.
No manipulation-check score→construct edge, behavior→psychological proxy shortcut, causal pathway, numerical weight, recommendation or active/governed candidate.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Bounded access, publication selection, shared self-report, convenience samples, unknown long-term transfer, source-alignment backlog and multidimensional effect scope require human review/further exact extraction. Local completion is not scientific completeness or final Layer reconciliation.
